summary: Batch F (final) of the BLOCKERS audit: wired 12 deferred-scope Personalities as personality-wave-22 (Agasha Kodo, Asahina Munefusa, Asako Rikate, Bayushi Nori, Hida Mimori, Isawa Kojiro, Isawa Mitsuko Experienced, Shosuro Hawado, Shosuro Rin, Soshi Neiru, Sutigu, Yoritomo Minori) plus Shinden Shorai as region-wave-3. Shared lane: the rules-side engine changes in src/L5R.Core/*.cs are the substance; publishing also adds the client's shipped runtime art (13 jpgs) and regenerates docs/CARD_INVENTORY.xlsx. New primitives: own-holding-with-keyword, enemy-bowed-card, air-shugenja-or-holding, honorable-personality, dynasty-card-in-any-discard and spell-in-hand-with-keyword Targets; own-source-or-unbowed-attached-with-keyword Performer; rikateDetach and rinShame PendingChoices with ReturnToHand generalized to detach in-play attachments; Kojiro's live conditional Naval; Minori's army-scoped per-Magistrate Force bonus; MatchEngine.BringProvincePersonalityIntoPlay shared by Your Clan Needs You! and Shinden Shorai; QuotePurchase's recruit-Clan Honor Requirement waiver parameter; Hawado's chosen-battlefield destination. See docs/decisions/2026-09-18-personality-wave-22-batch-f.md.
validation: dotnet run --project tests/L5R.Core.Tests (195/195 core incl. five new BatchF* tests with positive and negative assertions, 57/57 published, 9/9 deck-format, 10/10 deck-workshop; 12 of 13 targeted source mutations killed, the 13th an equivalent mutant); bash tools/check.sh --skip-client all green (Python tools/content 43 + tools/collaboration 130, AI 14/14, Server, Transport). PublishedTests pinned count recomputed from the origin/main baseline 375 -> 388 (12 Personalities + 1 Region). Client Godot build left to CI.
remaining: None; ready for review. Known limits noted in the decision doc: Munefusa uses the existing reinforcesFromElsewhere reading (waives player presence too); ability-payment UI for Neiru/Shorai matches the existing Low Market/Equip (Battle) client gap.
